svg.text: Pair pooling: one pocket region → one vector
A mean over the region keeps what it is made of and loses where the pieces sit. This keeps which kinds of site lie at which distances from each other.
1 Type every point, measure every pair
two small heads give each surface point a soft mix over 8 LEARNED
site types and a salience weight — not hand-assigned chemistry
distance is soft: 8 overlapping bins, 3–16 Å
pairs under 2 Å are dropped — that is one group with itself
2 Stack the counts into one vector
one distance histogram for every pair of types, kept as COUNTS
(two donors and five are different pockets), then log-scaled
